changes.summary: Editorial only. One process card named the application 'Rating Raider', which is the in-product agent; the software is Veteran-Ops (see docs/BRANDING.md). Corrected the product name in that card's prose. No rating criteria, diagnostic code, percentage, presumptive, secondary mapping, or eligibility rule was added, removed, or altered, and no criteria were re-verified against eCFR in this release, so verified_as_of is unchanged from 2026-07-25. The rule content fingerprint changes because it covers the byte content of every rule file.

Re-verified authored rating criteria, process rules, presumptives, secondary mappings, DBQ guidance, and corrections guidance against eCFR Title 38 after the 2026-07-13 title amendment. That amendment (FR 2026-14084) was a Loan Guaranty civil monetary penalties inflation notice with no Part 3/4 rating or eligibility impact; rule content fingerprint unchanged.
Established the first fingerprinted release baseline for authored rating criteria, process rules, presumptives, secondary mappings, DBQ guidance, corrections guidance, and vendor rule tables.
